discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 to packets 243/267 (and 208 for 2019 keys); reuses their keys, no new pins. 27 searches. Hold resolved: Hades gold/silver vs parent (DPB: LE 100 split evenly gold/silver). Holds kept: Captain Hook Pulse match, Chip n Dale Pulse match (strengthened), Neo Nouveau S1, LE 200 Dec 2019. Hold added: Pulse Cruella listing linked to 2019 Villain set by subject. Not found: P&F S2, Conducting Mickey A-C and D/E/F differences, Chilcott characters, launch prices. Out of window: Princess & Horse S2 (2021-01), floral series (2022), Ariel/Belle/Jasmine/Rapunzel LE (2022-01), Dopey & Doc (2024-11).
